subject: dsa
title: Edit Distance
summary: dp[i][j] is the minimum insert, delete, or replace operations to turn the first i chars of word1 into the first j chars of word2. Equal chars copy the diagonal; otherwise take 1 plus the smallest of the left, top, and diagonal neighbours.
problem: Find the minimum number of insert, delete, or replace operations to turn word1 = "sea" into word2 = "eat". Rows are prefixes of word1 ("", s, e, a); columns are prefixes of word2 ("", e, a, t). dp[i][j] is the edit distance of those prefixes.

steps.caption: Rows are word1 "sea", columns are word2 "eat". dp[i][j] is the edits to turn one prefix into the other.
Fill the base row and column. Turning a prefix into the empty string costs one delete per character, so they count up 0, 1, 2, 3.
Row 1 is char s. s matches none of e, a, t, so each cell is 1 plus the smallest neighbour: 1, 2, 3.
Row 2 is e and row 3 is a. e matches column e and a matches column a, copying those diagonals; the rest take 1 plus the smallest neighbour.
The bottom-right cell is 2, so 2 edits transform "sea" into "eat".
